task.description:
Design and implement tests for API-12 (Health endpoints) and produce/update the test spec.

Required deliverables:
- tests/specs/API-12.md with explicit test cases covering requirement acceptance criteria
- Relevant automated test source files for /health/live and /health/ready behavior, including degraded readiness cases

Coverage expectations:
1. GET /health/live returns HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok"} and no auth requirement
2. GET /health/ready returns HTTP 200 with {"status":"ok","db_latency_ms":N} when DB-04 health check succeeds
3. GET /health/ready returns HTTP 503 with structured failing-subsystem body on readiness failure
4. Pool exhausted and DB failure paths are explicitly covered as failing subsystem variants
5. Health endpoints continue to operate with API-09 trace assignment expectations
6. Tests assert endpoint behavior remains within API-12 constraints and does not regress existing API routes

Validation required in this handoff:
- zig build test exits 0

Update this handoff with result and artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-12.md exists and maps to API-12 acceptance criteria
Automated tests for /health/live and /health/ready success/failure behavior are implemented
Pool exhaustion and DB failure degraded responses are covered
Tests run successfully with zig build test
No regressions introduced in existing test suite

result.summary: Implemented API-12 test deliverables by creating tests/specs/API-12.md and extending automated Zig tests for /health/live and /health/ready success/degraded behavior, including explicit pool exhausted and DB failure variants, plus API-09 trace-context compatibility coverage. Validation passed with zig build test.
